title: Verify physical chip identity and FOSB address coverage in eligible Finnish assays
question: Which of the 38 clinically eligible native assays have a complete manufacturer address set and FOSB probe, and which case and control donors share chip, run and phase?
scope: Native raw address and clinical metadata census. Reuse the pinned v1 clinical selection and three manufacturer manifests. Freeze exact unique full-manifest address-set equality for a verified chip, report every other assay as missing, incomplete or ambiguous. Inspect no quantitative fields.
steps: Read native raw probe addresses through the end of the table, validating the PG stream boundary and native foreign key.
Classify all pre-eligible assays against each complete Illumina manifest, retaining assay and address keys only.
Report aggregate coverage and case/control overlap within chip, run and histologic phase.
deliverables: Pinned source range, offline census, synthetic safeguards and aggregate findings, including unresolved assays.
acceptance: Account for all 38 single-assay donors, including absent raw coverage.
Check the physical FOSB address within verified chip before declaring coverage. Count repeated raw address records independently.
Report only aggregates, without inspecting or converting signal or other quantitative fields.
